hero.title: Track expenses by <primary>just typing</primary> them. It's <feature>that simple</feature>.
hero.sub: MoMo turns the boring part of personal finance into a chat. Type "15.50 lunch chipotle" and we'll handle it for you.

mobile.ariaPreviewLabel: Preview of typing a message and creating an expense

chat.title: Chat is the form.
chat.body: Type the amount and a couple words. MoMo parses it into an expense, picks a category, and logs it. Edit later if you want.

scope.title: Personal & group chats.
scope.body: A private chat just for you, and a shared chat for the people you live with.

stats.title: Stats that don't lie.
stats.body: Forget about ugly charts and spreadsheets. MoMo shows you what you really care about.

step1.title: Just write.
step1.body: "15.50 lunch chipotle" · "4 coffee" · "22 uber to airport". Whatever feels natural.

step2.title: I'll guess the category.
step2.body: Food, Transit, Groceries, Fun. If I get it wrong you'll see "needs category" and you tap once to fix it.

step3.title: Stats appear, quietly.
step3.body: The Stats tab updates in real time. Nothing nags you. You just have a number when you want one.

closer.title:
More money.

More fun.
closer.sub: Sign up free. Bring your household if you like — or don't, I won't judge.
